name: Creamy "Caesar" Chickpea Toasts with Romaine, Grape & Pecan Salad

instructions.primary_message: Divide dressing between two large bowls. (Set one bowl aside for the romaine salad.)
Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the first bowl with the dressing along with salt and pepper. Using a fork or potato masher, roughly mash chickpeas until semi-smooth. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (15 oz) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to broil on high and position rack in the upper third of the oven. (Skip this step if you are using a toaster for the bread.)
Wash, dry, and halve grapes. Add to the second bowl with the dressing.
Wash, dry, and chop (or tear) lettuce into bite-sized pieces. Add to the bowl.
Roughly chop pecans and add to the bowl. Toss to combine the salad and set aside.

Divide bread between two baking sheet pans. Working in batches, place in the oven and broil, flipping halfway through, until toasted, about 2 minutes; remove from oven. (Alternatively, you can use a toaster.)
Divide toast between plates and top with chickpea salad. Serve with romaine salad on the side and enjoy!
